pred_sql:
SELECT COUNT(*)
FROM satscores s
JOIN schools sc ON s.cds = sc.CDSCode
WHERE s.AvgScrMath > 400
  AND sc.Virtual = 'F'

SELECT CDSCode
FROM frpm
WHERE `Enrollment (K-12)` + `Enrollment (Ages 5-17)` > 500

SELECT MAX(f.`Free Meal Count (Ages 5-17)` / f.`Enrollment (Ages 5-17)`) AS highest_eligible_free_rate
FROM satscores s
JOIN frpm f ON s.cds = f.CDSCode
WHERE s.NumTstTakr > 0
  AND CAST(s.NumGE1500 AS REAL) / s.NumTstTakr > 0.3
  AND f.`Enrollment (Ages 5-17)` > 0

SELECT sc.School AS school_name,
       sc.CharterNum AS charter_number,
       s.AvgScrWrite AS avg_writing_score,
       RANK() OVER (ORDER BY s.AvgScrWrite DESC) AS writing_rank
FROM satscores s
JOIN schools sc ON s.cds = sc.CDSCode
WHERE s.AvgScrWrite > 499
  AND sc.CharterNum IS NOT NULL
ORDER BY s.AvgScrWrite DESC

SELECT s.School,
       s.Street,
       s.City,
       s.State,
       s.Zip
FROM frpm f
JOIN schools s ON s.CDSCode = f.CDSCode
WHERE f.`Enrollment (K-12)` - f.`Enrollment (Ages 5-17)` > 30

SELECT T1.`School Name`
FROM frpm AS T1
INNER JOIN satscores AS T2
    ON T1.CDSCode = T2.cds
WHERE T1.`Free Meal Count (K-12)` * 1.0 / T1.`Enrollment (K-12)` > 0.1
  AND T2.NumGE1500 >= 1500

SELECT s.School, s.FundingType
FROM schools s
JOIN satscores sat ON s.CDSCode = sat.cds
WHERE s.County = 'Riverside'
  AND sat.AvgScrMath > 400

SELECT s.School AS school_name,
       sat.AvgScrWrite AS avg_writing_score,
       s.Phone AS communication_number
FROM schools s
INNER JOIN satscores sat ON sat.cds = s.CDSCode
WHERE strftime('%Y', s.OpenDate) > '1991'
   OR strftime('%Y', s.ClosedDate) < '2000'

SELECT `Free Meal Count (K-12)` * 1.0 / `Enrollment (K-12)` AS eligible_free_rate
FROM frpm
WHERE `Enrollment (K-12)` IS NOT NULL
ORDER BY `Enrollment (K-12)` DESC
LIMIT 2 OFFSET 9

WITH diffs AS (
    SELECT s.School AS school_name,
           s.DOCType AS doc_type,
           f.`Enrollment (K-12)` - f.`Enrollment (Ages 5-17)` AS diff
    FROM frpm f
    JOIN schools s ON f.CDSCode = s.CDSCode
    WHERE s.FundingType = 'Locally funded'
)
SELECT school_name, doc_type
FROM diffs
WHERE diff > (SELECT AVG(diff) FROM diffs)

SELECT s.Phone
FROM satscores AS sat
JOIN schools AS s ON s.CDSCode = sat.cds
WHERE sat.dname = 'Fresno Unified'
  AND sat.AvgScrRead IS NOT NULL
ORDER BY sat.AvgScrRead ASC
LIMIT 1

SELECT s.Street, s.City, s.Zip, s.State
FROM satscores sat
JOIN schools s ON s.CDSCode = sat.cds
WHERE sat.NumGE1500 IS NOT NULL
  AND sat.NumTstTakr > 0
ORDER BY CAST(sat.NumGE1500 AS REAL) / sat.NumTstTakr ASC
LIMIT 1

WITH top_school AS (
    SELECT cds
    FROM satscores
    WHERE NumGE1500 IS NOT NULL
    ORDER BY NumGE1500 DESC
    LIMIT 1
)
SELECT s.AdmFName1 AS first_name, s.AdmLName1 AS last_name
FROM schools s
JOIN top_school t ON s.CDSCode = t.cds
WHERE s.AdmFName1 IS NOT NULL OR s.AdmLName1 IS NOT NULL
UNION ALL
SELECT s.AdmFName2, s.AdmLName2
FROM schools s
JOIN top_school t ON s.CDSCode = t.cds
WHERE s.AdmFName2 IS NOT NULL OR s.AdmLName2 IS NOT NULL
UNION ALL
SELECT s.AdmFName3, s.AdmLName3
FROM schools s
JOIN top_school t ON s.CDSCode = t.cds
WHERE s.AdmFName3 IS NOT NULL OR s.AdmLName3 IS NOT NULL

WITH ranked AS (
    SELECT s.School,
           s.County,
           sat.AvgScrRead,
           ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY s.County ORDER BY sat.AvgScrRead DESC) AS rn
    FROM schools s
    JOIN satscores sat ON sat.cds = s.CDSCode
    WHERE s.Virtual = 'F'
      AND sat.AvgScrRead IS NOT NULL
)
SELECT School
FROM ranked
WHERE rn <= 5

SELECT COUNT(*) * 1.0 / 12 AS monthly_average_opened_1980
FROM schools
WHERE County = 'Alameda'
  AND DOC = '52'
  AND strftime('%Y', OpenDate) = '1980'

SELECT s.School, AVG(sat.AvgScrWrite) AS avg_writing_score
FROM schools s
JOIN satscores sat ON sat.cds = s.CDSCode
WHERE (s.AdmFName1 = 'Ricci' AND s.AdmLName1 = 'Ulrich')
   OR (s.AdmFName2 = 'Ricci' AND s.AdmLName2 = 'Ulrich')
   OR (s.AdmFName3 = 'Ricci' AND s.AdmLName3 = 'Ulrich')
GROUP BY s.CDSCode, s.School

SELECT s.School, f.`Enrollment (K-12)`
FROM schools s
JOIN frpm f ON f.CDSCode = s.CDSCode
WHERE s.DOC = '31'
  AND f.`Enrollment (K-12)` = (
      SELECT MAX(f2.`Enrollment (K-12)`)
      FROM schools s2
      JOIN frpm f2 ON f2.CDSCode = s2.CDSCode
      WHERE s2.DOC = '31'
  )

SELECT CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN DOC = '54' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS REAL)
       / SUM(CASE WHEN DOC = '52' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS ratio
FROM schools
WHERE County = 'Orange'
  AND StatusType = 'Merged'

SELECT County, COUNT(*) AS num_schools
FROM schools
WHERE County IN ('San Diego', 'Santa Barbara')
  AND Virtual = 'F'
GROUP BY County
ORDER BY num_schools DESC
LIMIT 1

SELECT `School Name`,
       `FRPM Count (Ages 5-17)` * 100.0 / `Enrollment (Ages 5-17)` AS `Percent (%) Eligible FRPM (Ages 5-17)`
FROM frpm
WHERE `County Name` = 'Los Angeles'
  AND `Low Grade` = 'K'
  AND `High Grade` = '9'

SELECT GSoffered
FROM schools
WHERE Longitude IS NOT NULL
ORDER BY ABS(Longitude) DESC
LIMIT 1

SELECT COUNT(*)
FROM schools s
JOIN frpm f ON s.CDSCode = f.CDSCode
WHERE s.County = 'Los Angeles'
  AND s.Charter = 0
  AND f.`Free Meal Count (K-12)` * 100.0 / f.`Enrollment (K-12)` < 0.18
SELECT name FROM cards WHERE cardKingdomFoilId IS NOT NULL AND cardKingdomId IS NOT NULL

SELECT DISTINCT c.name
FROM cards c
JOIN legalities l ON l.uuid = c.uuid
WHERE c.rarity = 'mythic'
  AND l.status = 'Banned'
  AND l.format = 'gladiator'

SELECT f.`Percent (%) Eligible Free (K-12)`, f.`District Code`
FROM schools s
JOIN frpm f ON f.CDSCode = s.CDSCode
WHERE s.AdmFName1 = 'Alusine'

SELECT l.status
FROM cards AS c
JOIN legalities AS l ON c.uuid = l.uuid
WHERE c.types = 'Artifact'
  AND c.side IS NULL
  AND l.format = 'vintage'

SELECT c.name, c.artist, c.isPromo
FROM cards AS c
JOIN rulings AS r ON r.uuid = c.uuid
GROUP BY c.uuid
ORDER BY COUNT(r.id) DESC
LIMIT 1

SELECT s.City,
       COUNT(*) AS magnet_k8_schools,
       SUM(CASE WHEN f.`NSLP Provision Status` = 'Multiple Provision Types' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS multiple_provision_schools
FROM schools s
JOIN frpm f ON s.CDSCode = f.CDSCode
WHERE s.Magnet = 1
  AND f.`Low Grade` = 'K'
  AND f.`High Grade` = '8'
GROUP BY s.City
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM cards WHERE power = '*'

SELECT CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN language = 'Chinese Simplified' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS REAL) * 100 / COUNT(id) AS chinese_simplified_percentage
FROM foreign_data

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT c.uuid)
FROM cards AS c
JOIN legalities AS l ON c.uuid = l.uuid
WHERE l.status = 'Banned'
  AND c.borderColor = 'white'

SELECT COUNT(*) AS unknown_power_triggered_ability_cards
FROM cards
WHERE (power IS NULL OR power = '*')
  AND text LIKE '%triggered ability%'

SELECT DISTINCT st.language
FROM sets s
JOIN set_translations st ON st.setCode = s.code
WHERE s.baseSetSize = 180
  AND s.block = 'Ravnica'

SELECT DISTINCT fd.type
FROM cards c
INNER JOIN foreign_data fd ON c.uuid = fd.uuid
WHERE fd.language = 'German'
  AND c.subtypes IS NOT NULL
  AND c.supertypes IS NOT NULL

SELECT CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN c.hasContentWarning = 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS REAL) * 100.0 / COUNT(c.id) AS percentage
FROM legalities AS l
JOIN cards AS c ON l.uuid = c.uuid
WHERE l.format = 'commander' AND l.status = 'legal'

SELECT id,
       (SELECT CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN isTextless = 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS REAL) * 100 / COUNT(*)
        FROM cards
        WHERE isStorySpotlight = 1) AS percentage
FROM cards
WHERE isStorySpotlight = 1
  AND isTextless = 0
ORDER BY id

SELECT language
FROM foreign_data
WHERE multiverseid = 149934

SELECT language
FROM foreign_data
WHERE name = 'A Pedra Fellwar'

SELECT DISTINCT st.language
FROM set_translations AS st
JOIN sets AS s ON st.setCode = s.code
WHERE s.mcmName = 'Archenemy'
  AND s.code = 'ARC'

SELECT name, convertedManaCost
FROM cards
WHERE name IN ('Serra Angel', 'Shrine Keeper')
ORDER BY convertedManaCost DESC
LIMIT 1

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT s.id)
FROM sets s
JOIN set_translations st ON st.setCode = s.code
WHERE s.block = 'Ice Age'
  AND st.language = 'Italian'
  AND st.translation IS NOT NULL

SELECT CASE WHEN EXISTS (
    SELECT 1
    FROM cards c
    JOIN foreign_data f ON f.uuid = c.uuid
    WHERE c.name = 'Ancestor''s Chosen'
      AND f.language = 'Korean'
) THEN 'Yes' ELSE 'No' END AS has_korean_version

SELECT DISTINCT s.isForeignOnly
FROM cards c
JOIN sets s ON c.setCode = s.code
WHERE c.name = 'Adarkar Valkyrie'

SELECT COUNT(*)
FROM sets s
WHERE s.baseSetSize < 10
  AND EXISTS (
    SELECT 1
    FROM set_translations st
    WHERE st.setCode = s.code
      AND st.language = 'Italian'
      AND st.translation IS NOT NULL
  )

SELECT DISTINCT c.artist
FROM cards c
JOIN sets s ON c.setCode = s.code
WHERE s.name = 'Coldsnap'
  AND c.artist IN ('Jeremy Jarvis', 'Aaron Miller', 'Chippy')

SELECT fd.flavorText
FROM foreign_data AS fd
JOIN cards AS c ON fd.uuid = c.uuid
WHERE c.name = 'Ancestor''s Chosen'
  AND fd.language = 'Italian'

SELECT COUNT(*) AS unknown_power_count
FROM cards AS c
JOIN sets AS s ON c.setCode = s.code
WHERE s.name = 'Coldsnap'
  AND c.convertedManaCost > 5
  AND (c.power = '*' OR c.power IS NULL)

SELECT CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN c.cardKingdomFoilId IS NOT NULL AND c.cardKingdomId IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS REAL) * 100 / COUNT(*) AS percentage
FROM cards AS c
WHERE c.setCode = (SELECT s.code FROM sets AS s WHERE s.name = 'Coldsnap')

SELECT fd.name
FROM foreign_data fd
JOIN cards c ON fd.uuid = c.uuid
WHERE c.setCode = (SELECT code FROM sets WHERE name = 'Coldsnap')
  AND fd.language = 'Italian'
  AND c.convertedManaCost = (
      SELECT MAX(convertedManaCost)
      FROM cards
      WHERE setCode = (SELECT code FROM sets WHERE name = 'Coldsnap')
  )

SELECT c.name, l.format
FROM cards AS c
JOIN legalities AS l ON l.uuid = c.uuid
WHERE c.edhrecRank = 1
  AND l.status = 'Banned'

SELECT DISTINCT s.name
FROM sets s
JOIN set_translations t ON s.code = t.setCode
WHERE t.language = 'Korean'
  AND NOT EXISTS (
      SELECT 1
      FROM set_translations j
      WHERE j.setCode = s.code
        AND j.language LIKE '%Japanese%'
  )

SELECT DisplayName
FROM users
WHERE CreationDate >= '2011-01-01' AND CreationDate < '2012-01-01'

SELECT DISTINCT c.name, l.format
FROM cards c
JOIN sets s ON c.setCode = s.code
JOIN legalities l ON l.uuid = c.uuid
WHERE s.name = 'Hour of Devastation'
  AND l.status = 'Legal'

SELECT COUNT(*) AS UserCount
FROM users
WHERE LastAccessDate > '2014-09-01'

SELECT DISTINCT c.frameVersion AS frameStyle,
       c.name AS cardName,
       l.status AS bannedStatus
FROM cards c
LEFT JOIN legalities l
       ON l.uuid = c.uuid
      AND l.status = 'Banned'
WHERE c.artist = 'Allen Williams'

SELECT p.Body
FROM tags t
JOIN posts p ON p.Id = t.ExcerptPostId
WHERE t.TagName = 'bayesian'

SELECT u.DisplayName
FROM posts p
JOIN users u ON u.Id = p.OwnerUserId
WHERE p.Title = 'Eliciting priors from experts'

SELECT u.DisplayName
FROM posts AS p
JOIN users AS u ON u.Id = p.LastEditorUserId
WHERE p.Title = 'Examples for teaching: Correlation does not mean causation'

SELECT AVG(p.Score) AS AverageScore
FROM posts AS p
INNER JOIN users AS u ON p.OwnerUserId = u.Id
WHERE u.DisplayName = 'csgillespie'

SELECT CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN u.Age > 65 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS REAL) * 100.0 / COUNT(p.Id) AS Percentage
FROM posts p
LEFT JOIN users u ON p.OwnerUserId = u.Id
WHERE p.Score > 5

SELECT p.FavoriteCount
FROM comments c
INNER JOIN posts p ON p.Id = c.PostId
WHERE c.UserId = 3025
  AND c.CreationDate = '2014/4/23 20:29:39.0'

SELECT COUNT(p.Id) AS PostCount
FROM users u
JOIN posts p ON p.OwnerUserId = u.Id
WHERE u.DisplayName = 'Tiago Pasqualini'

SELECT u.DisplayName
FROM votes v
JOIN users u ON u.Id = v.UserId
WHERE v.Id = 6347

SELECT CASE WHEN p.ClosedDate IS NULL THEN 'Yes' ELSE 'No' END AS WellFinished
FROM comments c
JOIN posts p ON c.PostId = p.Id
WHERE c.UserId = 23853
  AND c.CreationDate = '2013-07-12 09:08:18.0'
SELECT Text FROM comments WHERE Score = 17

SELECT ViewCount
FROM posts
WHERE Title = 'Integration of Weka and/or RapidMiner into Informatica PowerCenter/Developer'

SELECT u.DisplayName
FROM posts AS p
JOIN users AS u ON p.OwnerUserId = u.Id
WHERE p.Title = 'Open source tools for visualizing multi-dimensional data'

SELECT DISTINCT u.DisplayName
FROM votes v
JOIN posts p ON v.PostId = p.Id
JOIN users u ON v.UserId = u.Id
WHERE v.BountyAmount = 50
  AND p.Title LIKE '%variance%'

SELECT DISTINCT u.DisplayName
FROM comments AS c
JOIN users AS u ON u.Id = c.UserId
WHERE c.Text LIKE 'thank you user93%'

SELECT COUNT(*) AS UserCount
FROM (
    SELECT UserId
    FROM badges
    GROUP BY UserId
    HAVING COUNT(Name) > 5
) AS t

SELECT
    SUM(CASE WHEN strftime('%Y', Date) = '2010' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) * 100.0 / COUNT(Name)
  - SUM(CASE WHEN strftime('%Y', Date) = '2011' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) * 100.0 / COUNT(Name)
  AS PercentageDifference
FROM badges
WHERE Name = 'Student'

SELECT CAST(SUM(u.UpVotes) AS REAL) / COUNT(u.Id) AS avg_upvotes,
       CAST(SUM(u.Age) AS REAL) / COUNT(u.Id) AS avg_age
FROM users u
WHERE u.Id IN (
    SELECT p.OwnerUserId
    FROM posts p
    GROUP BY p.OwnerUserId
    HAVING COUNT(p.Id) > 10
)

SELECT CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN strftime('%Y', CreationDate) = '2010' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS REAL)
       / SUM(CASE WHEN strftime('%Y', CreationDate) = '2011' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS ratio
FROM votes

SELECT u.DisplayName, SUM(p.ViewCount) AS TotalViews
FROM posts p
JOIN users u ON p.OwnerUserId = u.Id
WHERE u.DisplayName IN ('Harvey Motulsky', 'Noah Snyder')
GROUP BY u.DisplayName
ORDER BY TotalViews DESC
LIMIT 1

SELECT CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN p.Tags LIKE '%<r>%' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS REAL) * 100.0 / COUNT(p.Id) AS percentage
FROM posts p
JOIN users u ON p.OwnerUserId = u.Id
WHERE u.DisplayName = 'Community'

SELECT u.Id
FROM users u
WHERE u.Views >= 1000
  AND EXISTS (
      SELECT 1
      FROM postHistory ph
      WHERE ph.UserId = u.Id
  )
  AND NOT EXISTS (
      SELECT 1
      FROM postHistory ph
      WHERE ph.UserId = u.Id
      GROUP BY ph.PostId
      HAVING COUNT(*) > 1
  )

SELECT SUM(CASE WHEN u.DisplayName = 'Mornington' THEN p.ViewCount ELSE 0 END)
     - SUM(CASE WHEN u.DisplayName = 'Amos' THEN p.ViewCount ELSE 0 END) AS difference
FROM posts p
JOIN users u ON p.OwnerUserId = u.Id
WHERE u.DisplayName IN ('Mornington', 'Amos')

SELECT COUNT(pl.Id) * 1.0 / 12 AS avg_monthly_links
FROM postLinks pl
JOIN posts p ON pl.PostId = p.Id
WHERE strftime('%Y', pl.CreationDate) = '2010'
  AND p.AnswerCount <= 2

SELECT MIN(v.CreationDate) AS FirstVoteDate
FROM votes v
JOIN users u ON v.UserId = u.Id
WHERE u.DisplayName = 'chl'

SELECT u.DisplayName
FROM badges b
JOIN users u ON u.Id = b.UserId
WHERE b.Name = 'Autobiographer'
ORDER BY b.Date ASC
LIMIT 1

SELECT COUNT(*)
FROM (
    SELECT u.Id
    FROM users u
    JOIN posts p ON p.OwnerUserId = u.Id
    WHERE u.Location = 'United Kingdom'
    GROUP BY u.Id
    HAVING SUM(p.FavoriteCount) >= 4
) AS t

SELECT DISTINCT t.TagName
FROM posts p
JOIN users u ON p.OwnerUserId = u.Id
JOIN tags t ON p.Tags LIKE '%<' || t.TagName || '>%'
WHERE u.DisplayName = 'Mark Meckes'
  AND p.CommentCount = 0

SELECT p.Id, p.Title
FROM posts AS p
JOIN users AS u ON p.OwnerUserId = u.Id
WHERE u.DisplayName = 'Harvey Motulsky'
ORDER BY p.ViewCount DESC
LIMIT 1

SELECT p.Id, u.DisplayName
FROM posts p
LEFT JOIN users u ON p.OwnerUserId = u.Id
WHERE strftime('%Y', p.CreaionDate) = '2010'
ORDER BY p.FavoriteCount DESC
LIMIT 1

SELECT CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN strftime('%Y', p.CreaionDate) = '2011' AND u.Reputation > 1000 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS REAL) * 100.0 / COUNT(p.Id) AS percentage
FROM posts p
LEFT JOIN users u ON p.OwnerUserId = u.Id

SELECT p.ViewCount AS TotalViews,
       u.DisplayName AS LastPostedBy
FROM postHistory ph
JOIN posts p ON ph.PostId = p.Id
JOIN users u ON ph.UserId = u.Id
WHERE ph.Text = 'Computer Game Datasets'
ORDER BY ph.CreationDate DESC
LIMIT 1

SELECT DISTINCT u.Reputation, u.UpVotes
FROM comments c
JOIN users u ON u.Id = c.UserId
WHERE c.Text = 'fine, you win :)'

SELECT COUNT(c.Id) AS CommentsWithZeroScore
FROM posts p
JOIN comments c ON c.PostId = p.Id
WHERE p.CommentCount = 1
  AND c.Score = 0

SELECT l.format, c.name
FROM legalities AS l
JOIN cards AS c ON c.uuid = l.uuid
WHERE l.status = 'Banned'
  AND l.format = (
      SELECT format
      FROM legalities
      WHERE status = 'Banned'
      GROUP BY format
      ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC
      LIMIT 1
  )

SELECT CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN Currency = 'EUR' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS REAL) / SUM(CASE WHEN Currency = 'CZK' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS ratio
FROM customers

SELECT CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN u.UpVotes = 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS REAL) * 100 / COUNT(u.Id) AS percentage
FROM comments c
JOIN users u ON c.UserId = u.Id
WHERE c.Score BETWEEN 5 AND 10

SELECT y.CustomerID
FROM yearmonth AS y
JOIN customers AS c ON c.CustomerID = y.CustomerID
WHERE c.Segment = 'LAM'
  AND y.Date BETWEEN '201201' AND '201212'
GROUP BY y.CustomerID
ORDER BY SUM(y.Consumption) ASC
LIMIT 1

SELECT SUBSTR(y.Date, 5, 2) AS PeakMonth,
       SUM(y.Consumption) AS TotalConsumption
FROM yearmonth AS y
JOIN customers AS c ON y.CustomerID = c.CustomerID
WHERE c.Segment = 'SME'
  AND y.Date BETWEEN '201301' AND '201312'
GROUP BY y.Date
ORDER BY TotalConsumption DESC
LIMIT 1

SELECT SUM(Consumption) AS TotalConsumption
FROM yearmonth
WHERE CustomerID = 6
  AND Date BETWEEN '201308' AND '201311'

WITH seg AS (
    SELECT c.Segment AS Segment,
           SUM(CASE WHEN substr(y.Date, 1, 4) = '2013' THEN y.Consumption ELSE 0 END) AS c2013,
           SUM(CASE WHEN substr(y.Date, 1, 4) = '2012' THEN y.Consumption ELSE 0 END) AS c2012
    FROM yearmonth y
    JOIN customers c ON y.CustomerID = c.CustomerID
    WHERE c.Currency = 'EUR'
      AND c.Segment IN ('SME', 'LAM', 'KAM')
    GROUP BY c.Segment
)
SELECT Segment,
       (c2013 - c2012) AS Increase,
       (c2013 - c2012) * 100.0 / c2013 AS PercentageIncrease
FROM seg
ORDER BY PercentageIncrease DESC

SELECT CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN Consumption > 528.3 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS REAL) * 100.0 / COUNT(*) AS percentage
FROM yearmonth
WHERE Date = '201202'

SELECT
    SUM(CASE WHEN Currency = 'CZK' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS czk_smes,
    SUM(CASE WHEN Currency = 'EUR' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS eur_smes,
    SUM(CASE WHEN Currency = 'CZK' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)
      - SUM(CASE WHEN Currency = 'EUR' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS difference
FROM customers
WHERE Segment = 'SME'

SELECT DISTINCT g.Country
FROM "transactions_1k" AS t
JOIN gasstations AS g ON t.GasStationID = g.GasStationID
WHERE strftime('%Y-%m', t.Date) = '2013-06'

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT c.CustomerID) AS customer_count
FROM customers AS c
JOIN yearmonth AS y
  ON c.CustomerID = y.CustomerID
WHERE c.Currency = 'EUR'
  AND y.Consumption > 1000

SELECT DISTINCT p.Description
FROM "transactions_1k" AS t
JOIN gasstations AS g ON t.GasStationID = g.GasStationID
JOIN products AS p ON t.ProductID = p.ProductID
WHERE g.Country = 'CZE'

SELECT COUNT(*) AS transaction_count
FROM "transactions_1k" AS t
JOIN gasstations AS g ON t.GasStationID = g.GasStationID
WHERE g.Country = 'CZE'
  AND t.Date > '2012-01-01'

SELECT c.Currency
FROM "transactions_1k" t
JOIN customers c ON t.CustomerID = c.CustomerID
WHERE t.Date = '2012-08-24' AND t.Time = '16:25:00'

SELECT COUNT(*) AS cze_transactions
FROM "transactions_1k" AS t
JOIN gasstations AS g ON t.GasStationID = g.GasStationID
WHERE t.Date = '2012-08-26'
  AND t.Time BETWEEN '08:00:00' AND '09:00:00'
  AND g.Country = 'CZE'

SELECT c.Segment
FROM transactions_1k AS t
JOIN customers AS c ON t.CustomerID = c.CustomerID
WHERE t.Date = '2012-08-23'
  AND t.Time = '21:20:00'

SELECT g.Country
FROM transactions_1k AS t
INNER JOIN gasstations AS g ON t.GasStationID = g.GasStationID
WHERE t.Date = '2012-08-24'
  AND t.Price = 548.4

SELECT CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN Segment = 'Premium' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS REAL) * 100.0 / COUNT(*) AS PremiumPercentage
FROM gasstations
WHERE Country = 'SVK'

SELECT t.CustomerID,
       SUM(t.Price) AS total_spent,
       SUM(t.Price) * 1.0 / SUM(t.Amount) AS avg_price_per_item,
       c.Currency
FROM transactions_1k AS t
JOIN customers AS c ON t.CustomerID = c.CustomerID
GROUP BY t.CustomerID, c.Currency
ORDER BY total_spent DESC
LIMIT 1

SELECT T.team_long_name
FROM Match AS M
JOIN League AS L ON M.league_id = L.id
JOIN Team AS T ON M.away_team_api_id = T.team_api_id
WHERE L.name = 'Scotland Premier League'
  AND M.season = '2009/2010'
  AND M.away_team_goal > M.home_team_goal
GROUP BY M.away_team_api_id, T.team_long_name
ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC
LIMIT 1

SELECT (y12.total - y13.total) / y12.total AS consumption_decrease_rate
FROM (
    SELECT SUM(Consumption) AS total
    FROM yearmonth
    WHERE CustomerID = (
        SELECT CustomerID
        FROM transactions_1k
        WHERE Date = '2012-08-25' AND Price = 634.8
        LIMIT 1
    )
    AND substr(Date, 1, 4) = '2012'
) AS y12,
(
    SELECT SUM(Consumption) AS total
    FROM yearmonth
    WHERE CustomerID = (
        SELECT CustomerID
        FROM transactions_1k
        WHERE Date = '2012-08-25' AND Price = 634.8
        LIMIT 1
    )
    AND substr(Date, 1, 4) = '2013'
) AS y13

SELECT buildUpPlaySpeed
FROM Team_Attributes

WITH acc AS (
    SELECT account_id
    FROM loan
    WHERE date = '1993-07-05'
    ORDER BY loan_id
    LIMIT 1
),
b_start AS (
    SELECT balance
    FROM trans
    WHERE account_id = (SELECT account_id FROM acc)
      AND date <= '1993-03-22'
    ORDER BY date DESC, trans_id DESC
    LIMIT 1
),
b_end AS (
    SELECT balance
    FROM trans
    WHERE account_id = (SELECT account_id FROM acc)
      AND date <= '1998-12-27'
    ORDER BY date DESC, trans_id DESC
    LIMIT 1
)
SELECT (b_end.balance - b_start.balance) * 100.0 / b_start.balance AS increase_rate
FROM b_end, b_start

FROM results r

SELECT COUNT(*)
FROM (
    SELECT cr.constructorId
    FROM constructorResults cr
    JOIN constructors c ON c.constructorId = cr.constructorId
    WHERE c.nationality = 'Japanese'
      AND cr.points = 0
    GROUP BY cr.constructorId
    HAVING COUNT(cr.raceId) = 2
) AS t

WITH race AS (
    SELECT raceId
    FROM races
    WHERE year = 2008 AND name = 'Australian Grand Prix'
),
champ AS (
    SELECT milliseconds / 1000.0 AS t
    FROM results
    WHERE raceId = (SELECT raceId FROM race) AND positionOrder = 1
),
last_driver AS (
    SELECT CAST(REPLACE(time, '+', '') AS REAL) AS inc
    FROM results
    WHERE raceId = (SELECT raceId FROM race) AND time IS NOT NULL
    ORDER BY positionOrder DESC
    LIMIT 1
)
SELECT (last_driver.inc - champ.t) / (last_driver.inc + champ.t) * 100 AS percentage_faster
FROM champ, last_driver

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT d.driverId) AS french_driver_count
FROM drivers d
JOIN lapTimes l ON l.driverId = d.driverId
WHERE d.nationality = 'French'

WHERE ra.name = 'Chinese Grand Prix'
  AND ra.year = 2008

SELECT code FROM drivers WHERE nationality = 'American'

SELECT r.fastestLap
FROM results r
JOIN races ra ON r.raceId = ra.raceId
WHERE ra.year = 2009
  AND r.driverId = (
      SELECT ds.driverId
      FROM driverStandings ds
      JOIN races rc ON ds.raceId = rc.raceId
      WHERE rc.year = 2009 AND ds.position = 1
      ORDER BY rc.round DESC
      LIMIT 1
  )
  AND r.fastestLapTime IS NOT NULL
ORDER BY r.fastestLapTime ASC
LIMIT 1

SELECT COUNT(*) AS disqualified_finishers
FROM results
WHERE raceId > 50
  AND raceId < 100
  AND statusId = 2
  AND time IS NOT NULL

WITH last_race AS (
    SELECT year, MAX(round) AS maxround
    FROM races
    GROUP BY year
),
final_race AS (
    SELECT r.raceId, r.year
    FROM races r
    JOIN last_race l ON r.year = l.year AND r.round = l.maxround
),
champs AS (
    SELECT ds.driverId, fr.year
    FROM driverStandings ds
    JOIN final_race fr ON ds.raceId = fr.raceId
    WHERE ds.position = 1
),
champ_times AS (
    SELECT c.year,
           res.time AS t
    FROM champs c
    JOIN races r ON r.year = c.year
    JOIN results res ON res.raceId = r.raceId AND res.driverId = c.driverId
    WHERE res.time IS NOT NULL
      AND res.time LIKE '%:%:%'
      AND c.year < 1975
)
SELECT year,
       AVG(
           CAST(substr(t, 1, instr(t, ':') - 1) AS REAL) * 3600
         + CAST(substr(t, instr(t, ':') + 1, instr(substr(t, instr(t, ':') + 1), ':') - 1) AS REAL) * 60
         + CAST(substr(t, instr(t, ':') + instr(substr(t, instr(t, ':') + 1), ':') + 1) AS REAL)
       ) AS avg_time_seconds
FROM champ_times
GROUP BY year
ORDER BY year

WITH youngest AS (
    SELECT d.driverId, d.dob
    FROM drivers d
    WHERE d.driverId IN (SELECT driverId FROM qualifying)
    ORDER BY d.dob DESC
    LIMIT 1
),
first_q AS (
    SELECT r.year, r.name, r.date, r.time
    FROM qualifying q
    JOIN races r ON q.raceId = r.raceId
    JOIN youngest y ON q.driverId = y.driverId
    ORDER BY r.date ASC
    LIMIT 1
)
SELECT year, name, date, time
FROM first_q

SELECT d.forename || ' ' || d.surname AS fullname
FROM qualifying q
JOIN races r ON q.raceId = r.raceId
JOIN circuits c ON r.circuitId = c.circuitId
